label: Transverse freedom
title: Finite stacks pack; Rule32's correction tower adds no new whole-field distinctions through depth four on the tested rings
kind: Exact representation theorem and bounded diagnostic
summary: Every fixed finite strip packs into a 1D product alphabet, while unbounded independent width defeats any fixed alphabet/longitudinal-expansion budget. Rule32's inherited correction tuples remain source-bounded, and on rings 6–12 their whole-field partition is already saturated at depth zero through h=4.
takeaway: Adding deterministic correction rows is not the same as adding independent transverse freedom. A dimensional criterion needs a resource that cannot be removed by finite packing under a uniform representation contract.
